description: This Java source file defines the ResumeSourceBuilder class, a builder for creating a resilient Akka stream source that can automatically resume after failures. It manages backoff parameters, restart limits, seed management, and error mapping to facilitate robust stream processing.

classes.name: ResumeSourceBuilder
classes.description: A generic builder class that configures parameters for creating a resuming Akka stream source, including backoff durations, restart limits, seed functions, and error handling.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns the configured Akka Source that supports resuming with specified parameters.

methods.name: minBackoff
methods.description: Sets the minimum backoff duration after a recoverable error.

methods.name: maxBackoff
methods.description: Sets the maximum backoff duration after a recoverable error.

methods.name: maxRestarts
methods.description: Defines the maximum number of restart attempts before failing the stream; negative for unlimited.

methods.name: recovery
methods.description: Sets the recovery interval, after which backoff resets if no errors occur.

methods.name: initialSeed
methods.description: Sets the initial seed value for starting the stream.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Assigns the function to create or resume a stream from a seed.

methods.name: lookBehind
methods.description: Sets the number of recent stream elements to retain for seed computation.

methods.name: nextSeed
methods.description: Provides the function to derive the next seed from recent stream elements.

methods.name: mapError
methods.description: Sets the function to map errors to determine recoverability.
